info.title: Challenges API
info.description: REST API for organising and recording racing-simulator challenges. Participants register for car-and-track challenges, submit lap times, and compare results on a live leaderboard.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Services exposing information about the system availability, environment, the authenticated user etc.

tags.name: Conversation entries
tags.description: Administrative operations for independently identified challenge conversation entries.

tags.name: Challenges
tags.description: Services for browsing and administering racing-simulator challenges, including participant registration and lap-time results.

tags.name: Simulators
tags.description: Supported racing simulators used to classify cars, tracks, and challenges.

tags.name: Tracks
tags.description: Services for browsing and administering racing tracks available for challenges.

tags.name: Cars

404.description: No track exists with the supplied ID.

put.description: Replaces the mutable properties of the selected track. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

404.description: No track exists with the supplied ID.
No car exists with the supplied ID.

put.description: Replaces the mutable properties of the selected car. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

404.description: No car exists with the supplied ID.

post.description: Creates an enabled user authorized as `PARTICIPANT`. The username must be unique. This operation is public.

409.description: The supplied username is already in use.

get.description: Returns tracks matching the optional country, name, and length filters. Country and name searches are case- and diacritic-insensitive.

post.description: Creates a racing track that can be selected for challenges. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

201.description: Track created. The Location header identifies the new track.

get.description: Returns challenges matching the optional simulator, end-date, leaderboard, track, and car filters. The simulatorId identifies the simulator associated with both the selected car and track. Searches by text fields are case- and diacritic-insensitive.

post.description: Creates an active challenge for the selected car and track. Both must belong to the same simulator, which the challenge derives from them. Only one active challenge may exist for the same car-and-track combination. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

requestBody.description: The car, track, and inclusive challenge end date.

404.description: The selected car or track does not exist.

409.description: An active challenge already exists for the selected car and track.

422.description: The submitted end date does not satisfy the challenge rules.

post.description: Registers the authenticated participant for an active challenge. A participant cannot register twice and needs a previous win before joining multiple active challenges. Requires the `PARTICIPANT` role.

422.description: The challenge is closed, or the participant is not eligible to join multiple active challenges.

409.description: The authenticated participant is already registered for the challenge.

404.description: No challenge exists with the supplied ID.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated participant from an active challenge. Requires the `PARTICIPANT` role.

409.description: The authenticated participant is not registered for the challenge.

404.description: No challenge exists with the supplied ID.

post.description: Creates a top-level conversation entry in an active challenge for the authenticated registered participant. The participant name and best lap time are captured with the entry as historical values. Requires the `PARTICIPANT` role.

parameters.name: challengeId
parameters.description: ID of the challenge receiving the conversation entry.

requestBody.description: The conversation message, up to 1000 characters.

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the `PARTICIPANT` role.

409.description: The authenticated participant is not registered for the challenge.

Location.description: URI of the created conversation entry, `/conversation-entries/{entryId}`.

404.description: No challenge exists with the supplied ID.

post.description: Creates a reply to an entry in the same active challenge. The authenticated participant must be registered for the challenge. The participant name and best lap time are captured with the reply as historical values. Requires the `PARTICIPANT` role.

parameters.name: challengeId
parameters.description: ID of the challenge receiving the reply.

parameters.name: parentEntryId
parameters.description: ID of the conversation entry being replied to.

requestBody.description: The reply message, up to 1000 characters.

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the `PARTICIPANT` role.

409.description: The authenticated participant is not registered for the challenge.

Location.description: URI of the created conversation entry, `/conversation-entries/{entryId}`.

422.description: The challenge is closed, or the parent entry does not belong to this challenge.

404.description: No challenge exists with the supplied ID.

get.description: Returns cars matching the optional brand, name, horsepower, torque, and wheel-drive filters. Brand and name searches are case- and diacritic-insensitive.

post.description: Creates a car that can be selected for challenges. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

201.description: Car created. The Location header identifies the new car.

get.description: Returns the selected challenge, its car and track, the current leaderboard, registered participants, and conversation entries in chronological order from earliest to latest.

404.description: No challenge exists with the supplied ID.

delete.description: Deletes an active challenge. Closed challenges cannot be deleted. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

404.description: No challenge exists with the supplied ID.

patch.description: Changes the inclusive end date of an active challenge. Closed challenges cannot be changed. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

requestBody.description: The new inclusive challenge end date.

422.description: The challenge is closed or the submitted end date is invalid.

404.description: No challenge exists with the supplied ID.

patch.description: Records or removes a registered participant's best lap time. A participant may update only their own time while the challenge is active. An administrator may update any registered participant, including after the challenge closes. Requires the `PARTICIPANT` or `ADMIN` role.

requestBody.description: The registered participant and their new lap time. Set newLapTime to null to clear the recorded time.

422.description: A non-administrator attempted to update a lap time after the challenge closed.

404.description: The participant is not registered for the challenge.

403.description: A non-administrator attempted to update another participant's lap time.

get.description: Returns the username and authorization roles of the authenticated user.
Returns the supported simulators. Use the returned ID as simulatorId when creating a car or track.

Returns historical lap times newest-first. Each gap is the signed change from the preceding historical time (current minus previous): a negative gap means improvement and a positive gap means regression. The earliest historical time has a zero gap.

delete.description: Deletes the selected conversation entry. Any direct replies are preserved and become top-level entries. Requires the `ADMIN` role.

404.description: No conversation entry exists with the supplied ID.

400.description: The entry ID is not positive.

204.description: Conversation entry deleted; no response body is returned.

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the `ADMIN` role.

newLapTime.description: Lap time in m:ss.S, m:ss.SS, or m:ss.SSS format. Null clears the recorded lap time.

lapTime.description: Historical lap time in canonical mm:ss.SSS format.

updatedAt.description: Time when this historical lap time was recorded.

gap.description: Signed lap-time change from the preceding historical time, calculated as current lap time minus previous lap time. Negative means improvement; positive means regression. The earliest historical time has no predecessor and therefore a zero gap.

bestLapTime.description: Quickest recorded lap time, returned in canonical mm:ss.SSS format.
Quickest recorded lap time, returned in canonical mm:ss.SSS format.

conversation.description: Conversation entries ordered from earliest to latest by creation time, with entry ID ascending as the tie-breaker.

entryId.description: Unique identifier of the conversation entry.

parentEntryId.description: ID of the parent entry for a reply; null for a top-level entry.

message.description: Message content posted by the participant.

participantName.description: Participant name captured when the entry was posted.

participantLapTimeAtPosting.description: Participant's best lap time captured when the entry was posted, if available; serialized in canonical mm:ss.SSS format.

createdAt.description: Local date-time when the entry was created.

ConversationEntryDetailResponse.description: Conversation entries ordered from earliest to latest by creation time, with entry ID ascending as the tie-breaker.

participantBestLapTime.description: Participant's quickest recorded lap time, returned in canonical mm:ss.SSS format.
